info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Preapproval Listing API allows users to access a comprehensive list of mortgage loan preapproval applications. This endpoint serves mortgage lenders, loan officers, and financial institutions who need quick access to preapproval data for assessment and processing. By retrieving preapproval information, users can streamline their lending operations and make informed decisions. Typical use cases include handling inquiries about potential loans and integrating with internal workflow systems to improve efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information regarding loan preapproval. Use this to check the eligibility status for loans based on user input and criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a preapproval process for a loan. It must contain the relevant applicant information and financial details as specified in the schema.

201.description: Preapproval request processed successfully, resource has been created.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation related to loan preapproval.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.title: Preapproval Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the preapproval request.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the preapproval request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated from the preapproval process.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the preapproval request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the preapproval result.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the preapproval request.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Schema representing the response of a preapproval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information for a preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value indicates a faster response time.
